dataFlow.step: User submits payment form with full card number in req.body.cardNumber
Full card number is passed to createPaymentMethod and transmitted to api.stripe.com; the function returns only { id, last4 }
Only method.id (stripe ref) and method.last4 are written to the payments table; no card number column exists
Request logger only logs bodies for /api/signup and /api/login prefixes, not /api/payments
